messages:
tara_cs: Heads-up — SilverFern started a short APAC pilot and immediately hit the per-minute throttle; they asked for a staging CIDR exception + per-route bump.

leah_acct: Renewal risk flagged as moderate if pilot can't demonstrate stable latency. They request a 14-day window and want burst=470 rps on /v1/complete from staging CIDR.

tara_cs: @omar_net can you add staging CIDRs 203.0.119.0/28 and 198.51.105.128/28 and a header match X-Env:sf-staging? They mentioned they'll use the Atlas token.

omar_net: Will add ipset entries + a temporary rate window with auto-revoke TTL=14d. Suggest global_soft=700 to allow short spikes. Any per-route guardrails we should enforce?

noah_sre: Tagging SRE for quick risk review. I'll run noisy-neighbor and capacity checks and attach a small-model fallback if needed. ETA ~35m.

kv-prewarm-bot: Preflight OK for APAC. Recommend KV cache prewarm for SilverFern's prefix. Suggest p95 alert at 1400ms.

omar_net: Draft change snippet:

```
# SilverFern temp allowlist + rate window (auto-revoke 14d)
ipset add silverfern_203 203.0.119.0/28
ipset add silverfern_198 198.51.105.128/28
route /v1/complete burst=470 per_route_soft=470 global_soft=700 headers.allow=X-Env:sf-staging
# tag: silverfern-3210004321
```

omar_net: Opening JIRA INF-8033 and adding the patch. Auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-28; will include webhook to remove ipset.

tara_cs: Customer telemetry: 220-380ms median in us-east but 900-1600ms p95 in ap-southeast during spikes. They want token-level pin to ap-southeast-1 for the pilot but asked for a cost estimate first.

noah_sre: Token-level region pinning is possible; I'll calculate a cost delta and share with @leah_acct. We'll only enable pinning after explicit customer approval. Also will run KV prewarm before the prod flip.

leah_acct: Please send cost delta and update renewal tracker: "Pilot: APAC latency blocking conversion; temporary concession granted". We'll follow up on renewal if pilot meets SLA.

tara_cs: Scheduling an enablement + runbook session Friday with docs + ML support to validate prompts and observe quality under load. We'll capture hallucination/regression signals correlated with higher qps.

omar_net: Change queued pending SRE signoff (INF-8033). Adding header enforcement and TTL webhook.

noah_sre: Applied to staging; smoke tests green. Rolling to prod in ~10m. Alerts configured: p95 > 1600ms triggers rollback and small-model fallback.

tara_cs: :thumbsup: Ping me when live so I can notify SilverFern and run the Friday session.

omar_net: Live. CIDRs allowed, rate window active, header match enforced. Watchlist created: silverfern-3210004321.

tara_cs: Please capture customer sentiment after 24h and log any quality regressions. I'll add a follow-up on day 10 for usage + cost summary.

leah_acct: Added renewal action: send usage + cost summary on day 10 and schedule post-pilot review. Thanks team.
